fresh.question: What does it mean to be granted a partial discharge on my federal student loan?

review_units.label: supported
review_units.note: S1 nêu trừ số được xóa rồi xác định số dư.

v2.answer: A partial discharge means that the entire loan balance is not forgiven, but only a portion of it, leaving a remaining balance on your account. Your loan servicer will apply the borrower defense discharge to your student loan account and determine if you still owe any amount after the discharge is applied. If a balance remains, your servicer will apply prior payments to reduce the remaining balance on your account. [S1]
